patterns.note: Content sections, particularly on interior pages, frequently use an asymmetric two-column layout where a concise label on the left introduces a more detailed content block on the right.
Project showcases are presented as a grid of large, full-bleed image thumbnails, emphasizing visual work over descriptive text at a glance.
A single sans-serif font family is used consistently across all text, with hierarchy established primarily through size and weight variations rather than different typefaces.
The design relies on a high-contrast monochrome palette of black text on a white background, with a single bright blue used sparingly for interactive elements and accents.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site sections.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, remaining visible and accessible as the user scrolls down the page. Content scrolls naturally underneath without any other scroll-triggered animations or reveals.

Key content sections, particularly on interior pages, utilize an asymmetric two-column layout where a concise label or category on the left introduces a more detailed content block on the right, creating a structured, document-like appearance.
Project showcases are presented as a grid of large, full-bleed image thumbnails that serve as direct links to individual project pages, emphasizing visual work over descriptive text at a glance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2-3x body text) establish clear hierarchy, with all text using a consistent, clean sans-serif family.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (all corners are 0px radius, contributing to a crisp, modern aesthetic)
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal spacing, especially around text blocks and between sections, creating a highly readable and uncluttered presentation)

standout: This site distinguishes itself through an extremely minimalist, almost document-like presentation, particularly on its 'Information' page, which prioritizes dense, structured text over typical web visuals. The design feels less like a marketing site and more like a highly organized, professional resume or editorial piece, emphasizing the designer's content and expertise directly.
